title: El Nino

data.source: NOAA Climate Prediction Center, Oceanic Nino Index (ERSSTv5), 1950 onward

prediction: The gaps between El Ninos are more even than red noise (P1) and more even than a linear noise-driven oscillator (P2): the CV of the gaps is below the 5th percentile of 2000 surrogate records of each kind.
baseline: Surrogate records from an AR(1) red-noise process and from an AR(6) model fitted to the index.
why: The gaps are more even than red noise, but a linear damped oscillator with no threshold gives the same evenness. The count adds nothing to the standard picture.
